name: terminal_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
L=Path.cwd();excluded={'MANIFEST.json','terminal_manifest.receipt.json','terminal_manifest.output.txt'};files=[]
for p in sorted(L.rglob('*')):
 if not p.is_file():continue
 rel=str(p.relative_to(L))
 if rel in excluded:continue
 b=p.read_bytes();files.append({'path':rel,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
receipts=[x['path'] for x in files if x['path'].endswith('.receipt.json')];after=[x for x in files if 'after' in x['path']];assert after
v={'kind':'actual-byte-sha256-manifest','files':files,'completed_receipt_JSONs':receipts,'terminal_noncircular_exclusions':{'MANIFEST.json':'Manifest self-reference excluded','terminal_manifest.receipt.json':'Terminal runner receipt generated only after manifest child exits; explicitly excluded','terminal_manifest.output.txt':'Terminal runner output generated only after manifest child exits; explicitly excluded'},'scope':'All own-lane regular files except precisely named terminal noncircular exclusions; no peer access','frozen_after_present':after}
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),'MANIFEST.json'],input=json.dumps(v,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
print(json.dumps({'files':len(files),'completed_receipts_included':len(receipts),'frozen_after':[x['path'] for x in after],'survivors':0,'credit':0}))
